outcome: Rates of type 1, type 2, and gestational diabetes mellitus
cohort: Women with live births between 2005 and 2018 in Alberta, Canada.
finding: Between 2005 and 2018, the rates of gestational diabetes mellitus and type 2 diabetes mellitus in pregnancy more than doubled, while type 1 diabetes mellitus rates remained constant.
mod_finding: Women with T1DM had the highest rates of cesarean section deliveries (62%).
